items.headline: No. 13 Iowa shuts out Illinois in the second half, pulls away for 34-17 win to help playoff hopes
items.description: — L.J. Phillips Jr. ran for 154 yards and a touchdown, Iowa's stingy defense shut out Illinois in the second half, and the No. 13 Hawkeyes beat the Fighting Illini 34-17 on Saturday to give their College Football Playoff hopes a big boost.
